title: Sincerity of Purpose
arabic_text: عن [أبي رُقَيَّةَ تَميمِ بنِ أوْسٍ الدَّاريِّ] رَضِي اللهُ عَنْهُ أنَّ النَّبيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قالَ: "الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ". قُلْنَا: لِمَنْ؟ قالَ: "للهِ وَلِكِتَابِهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلأَِئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَعَامَّتِهِمْ".
english_translation: From Abū Ruqayyah Tamīm bin Aws al-Dārī (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhum) who said that the Prophet (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam) said, 'The religion is sincerity of purpose.' We said, 'To whom?' He said, 'To Allāh, His Book, His Messenger, the leaders of the Muslims and their general folk.'
description: This Hadith emphasizes the central role of 'Nasiha' (sincerity or sincere advice) in Islam, specifying its recipients: Allah, His Book, His Messenger, the Muslim leaders, and the general Muslim populace.
